title: PluginEditor full layout - header with Re-roll, voice section with pan strips, humanization rotaries, global controls, metering column, APVTS attachments, timer, resize, CMakeLists
description:
Sole PluginEditor and CMakeLists owner for phase d. Expand the a.4 editor skeleton into the full ShredDouble GUI per Build Spec §9.1 and register new GUI sources.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp skeleton from a.4 (Timer, ResizableCornerComponent, Re-roll stub)
- Source/StateManager.h (reRollMasterSeed / A/B APIs)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h and PluginProcessor APVTS accessors
- Source/GUI/DriftDisplay.h from d.1
- Source/GUI/RotarySlider, CustomLookAndFeel, GoniometerComponent, CorrelationMeter (reused)
- Source/DSP/MeterTap.h and how processor/engine expose MeterTap to the UI
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp (attachment, timer, layout, A/B, latency segmented patterns)
- CMakeLists.txt current source list from phases a–c
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §9.1–9.6, §13

Implement full ShredDoubleAudioProcessorEditor layout:
1. Header: plugin name label, preset selector ComboBox (factory list can be stub entries until phase e BinaryData; keep structure), A/B compare buttons (+ copy if StateManager supports), Re-roll TextButton wired to StateManager::reRollMasterSeed() (or processor façade that reseeds the engine), bypass control/LED via APVTS ButtonAttachment on bypass.
2. Voice section: voiceCount segmented 2/4 control; per-voice pan strips (panV1..panV4 RotarySliders or small sliders) — show/enable pans for active voices only (hide or disable V3/V4 when voiceCount==2).
3. Humanization section rotaries: Timing Spread, Pitch Spread, Humanization Rate, Tightness with SliderAttachments to timingSpread, pitchSpread, humanRate, tightness.
4. Global section: Low Mono Crossover, Stereo Width, Mix, Output Trim rotaries; Latency Mode segmented Studio/Live bound to latencyMode (mirror shred-width studio/live button pattern).
5. Metering column: GoniometerComponent (top), CorrelationMeter (middle), DriftDisplay (bottom). Wire MeterTap from processor/engine; timerCallback at 30–60 Hz calls goniometer.update(), correlationMeter update/setCorrelation, driftDisplay.update() and setVoiceCount from current voiceCount param.
6. Apply CustomLookAndFeel via setLookAndFeel in ctor and clear in dtor. Do not rewrite drawPopupMenuItem — reused CustomLookAndFeel already uses LookAndFeel_V4 individual-parameter signature.
7. ResizableCornerComponent / setResizable with constrained aspect or min/max sizes; persist window size in value tree state (APVTS state or processor property) like shred-width.
8. All continuous params use APVTS SliderAttachments; choice/bool via ButtonAttachment or ComboBoxAttachment / manual segmented sync matching existing ParameterIDs.
9. CMakeLists.txt: register Source/GUI/DriftDisplay.cpp (and ensure PluginEditor.cpp and other GUI sources already listed remain). Sole CMakeLists owner this phase — only add DriftDisplay / fix GUI source registration needed for this phase, no broad refactors.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Modify ONLY PluginEditor.h/.cpp and CMakeLists.txt. DriftDisplay implementation stays in d.1.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp implement full layout regions: header, voice, humanization, global, metering column

voiceCount 2/4 control and latencyMode Studio/Live segmented controls are bound to APVTS parameters

CustomLookAndFeel is applied on the editor
Editor is resizable with size constraints and window size stored in value tree / state
